attr.title: PortPad
attr.desc: Gamepad-first text editor and file manager for PortMaster-compatible handhelds. Browse and view UTF-8 files, edit with a controller keyboard, search, undo and save with backups.
attr.inst: Includes application and font. Uses firmware SDL2 and SDL2_ttf; no runtime downloads. Experimental aarch64 editor; installation and browser validated on R36S.
